commits.edited_message: Avoid redundant IDManifest parser preflight and preallocation (#2575)
Bound IDManifest size/version and streamline short string lengths (#2572)

coupling: The earlier parser cleanup removes the coarse check that at least one encoded length byte exists per declared string; its per-integer decoder still checks the input boundary, so that edit alone is safe. The later short-length fast path reads the first length byte directly; the original coarse check makes that edit safe alone. Together, a manifest declaring one string with no length bytes reaches a one-byte read past the supplied buffer. Review and repair must account for the preflight guarantee established in the earlier commit and consumed in the later one; restoring the preflight or adding a bound at the fast path removes the fault.
